thread:
marta: Heads-up: opened a draft PR adjusting glossary + SDK examples due to inconsistent naming (product shows 'model version', SDK examples use `model_revision`). PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501

docs-bot: automated check -> broken link detected in /sdk/js/README.md line ~42 (404).

laura: I'll take the glossary edit if we decide on the canonical user term.

sahil: Vote: user-facing term should be 'model version' to match UI and be friendlier to non-ML readers.

kevin: Context: internal runtime/telemetry uses `model_revision`. We can't change server response names immediately without extra coordination. Proposal: docs prefer 'model version' and note the internal name; SDKs accept both names and deprecate the old one later.

marta: Proposed plan:
1) Update glossary to treat 'model version' as canonical and mention `model_revision` as legacy/internal.
2) Add a short migration snippet in SDK docs showing preferred and legacy forms.
3) Implement aliasing in Python/JS SDKs (deprecation warning when old name used).
4) Fix the 404 in js README.

kevin: I'll open the SDK PR to alias parameters and add unit tests asserting identical behavior. Will emit DeprecationWarning/console.warn when legacy param used. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

laura: I'll update glossary.md and add a migration note linking to SDK examples. I'll also fix the broken link in /sdk/js/README.md.

sahil: Can someone add a one-liner for release notes so GTM teams know about the wording change?

marta: I'll draft the release-note blurb and ping growth.

docs-bot: reminder: include CHANGELOG entry for SDK PRs and ensure linter/tests pass.

marta: Action items summarized: laura update glossary + migration note + fix link (assigned); kevin add SDK alias + tests + changelog (in progress); marta add release-note blurb (todo); sahil review release-note (todo). I'll post PR numbers when available.
